description: Generate a Tableau workbook (.twb or .twbx) from a CSV file and a natural-language prompt. Returns the path to the generated workbook.

csv_path.description: Absolute path to the source CSV file.

output_path.description: Absolute path where the generated workbook should be saved. Extension determines format (.twb or .twbx).

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the dashboard to generate (e.g. 'quarterly revenue by region with YoY comparison').

style.description: Optional style hint: 'corporate', 'executive', 'analytical', or a custom description.

name: generate_workbook
